review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability (CS_GAME_DIR and CS_ENGINE_IMAGE set); this report is derived from the recorded log plus a second record, slot-map-and-status.json, holding the engine image digest, the resolution and the limitations. MEASURED by static analysis of the owner-supplied decrypted executable (byte windows pinned in the acceptance tests): a plane record's eight rocket slots (record +0xa8, table 0x62ae38..0x62ae58, bound 0x443f26) hold rocket type ids 0..11, and 0x4440f0 (range check cmp ecx,0xa at 0x4440f7, jump table 0x444148) maps ids 0..10 to record indices 5..15 only, so no airframe slot can hold wep_04, wep_24, wep_25, wep_26 or wep_27; the preset binder (0x444269) uses the same mapper, the installer 0x4b24d0 walks slots 0..11 (0x4b250b), and the only writer that can name another index is the mission command at 0x43e530 (0x43e553 one slot, 0x43e56a all eight rocket slots, argument reader 0x5b7980 with no range check), which is script content and is follow-up #2173. The SONIC (0x200) and FLASH (0x800) bits are tested together at 0x4b9d84 (test ch,0x0a) and run the exposure 0x42e840: ratio = squared distance / IMPACT_PROXIMITY^2 (the record's +0x3c squared at 0x4ba590, parsed at 0x5add6a), intensity = clamp(1 - 2.5*(ratio - 0.6), 0, 1) (0x42e87e, constants 0x60411c and 0x6040a8), FLASH additionally scaled by clamp(2*dot(facing),0,1) (0x42e8ed), duration = intensity*5.0 s (0x42e9b1). The player actor takes a screen/audio exposure only (0x4ba5bf, 0x42e9d0) with no control loss; every other actor that passes 0x4200d0's gate (not the player, +0x91d == 0, +0xf8 == 0, +0x67c in {0,4}) gets mode +0x358 = 4, six control words zeroed and clock + duration at +0xc0, cleared by 0x489acd..0x489ae9 when the clock reaches it. cs_sim::weapons::ordnance::StatusEffectKind has no pilot-incapacitation variant (Damage/Choke/Stall/Marker), so no variant is forced: the claim t452_r02.limit.status_incapacitation is kept and the variant is follow-up #2172. The claim is implemented: this awards nothing above that, and no agent review replaces the owner's human approval. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
